description:
GISGP Lite (a 24-hour pass, a 7-day pass or a monthly plan) — pass the api_key of that
    account (or Authorization: Bearer). height above mean
    sea level of one point from Copernicus GLO-30 (30 m), read from the public elevation model
    (GLO-90 fallback). Returns JSON {ok, elevation_m, source, resolution_m, credit}; elevation_m is
    null at sea. For a free, coarser answer use get_terrain_profile.
name: get_elevation
